items.title: Chuck Findley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 6, 2023
items.q: I recently watched this marvelous performance of yours with “Nature Boy” and the James Last Orchestra.

ctx.x: Absolutely. I — getting back to that, the doit, the [scats] and it’s an F sharp, E concert. It’s very hard to dip into that note. And Burt Bacharach of course, who wrote the song, I don’t know if you know that Burt was very particular with what he wanted. We’d do something twelve times and end up with the first one. You know but you know you’re talking about the separation of [scats] — that’s the wrong key [scats] You know? Okay so now getting back to doubling and that, I wore the cans, always on one ear and off…
You answered a question I was going to ask because I recently watched this marvelous performance of yours with “Nature Boy” and the James Last Orchestra.
